Usage: ocfl stage new --id=STRING [flags]

Create a new stage for preparing updates to an object

Flags:
  -h, --help                      Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING               The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root
                                  used for the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug                     enable debug log messages

  -f, --file="ocfl-stage.json"    path to stage file
      --alg="sha512"              Digest Algorithm used to digest content.
                                  Ignored for existing objects.
  -i, --id=STRING                 object id for the new stage
